name: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3
description: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3 is Mistral's speech-to-text model for transcription with speaker diarization and timestamps at a low per-minute price. It is suited to captioning, meeting notes, call analytics, and batch transcription pipelines. It is in public preview.

sources.notes: Official model identity, version, public-preview status, transcription route, and $0.0035 per-minute price. The card shows October 20, 2026 as its date, used here as the release date.
Endpoint-level transcription parameters (language, temperature, stream, diarize, context_bias, timestamp_granularities).

verification.notes: Identity, price, and route verified against Mistral's model card. Parameter support is taken from the shared transcription endpoint reference; the card does not list it per model.
